limitations: This cycle (WS2025/26) had already opened, closed, and begun teaching before this research's retrieval date (2026-08-21) — kept deliberately as a historical record, not restated as current. deadline_date is set to the closing date of the stated range (15 May 2025); the source gives a range, not a single day, and this schema has one date field.
researcher_notes: cycle_year intentionally left null despite recurrence being dated_specific and deadline_date being populated: the source's explicit calendar date (15 May 2025) is unambiguous and safe to store, but this record contract's own two worked examples for German Wintersemester-labelled cycles give contradictory conventions for which half of a 'YYYY/YY' label the entry-year field should carry — that is a separate ambiguity from the date itself. The research-handoff doc's requirement-record example states 'Winter Semester 2026/27 entry, cycle_year is 2027' (the later year), while the deadline-record instructions for this same task state 'an October 2026 deadline for Wintersemester 2026/27 ... commonly the year teaching starts' (2026, the earlier year) — for what is structurally the identical input. Rather than silently pick one convention, cycle_label carries the source's own unambiguous string ('Wintersemester 2025/26') and cycle_year is left null pending a decision from the engineering/coordination lane. Flagged prominently in this batch's final report.
